messages:
Maya (growth): Quick heads-up — the new weekly leadflow dashboard shows a ~42% drop in webinar->MQL conversion overnight. Not sure if it's attribution or a pipeline issue.
Olivia (analytics): tagging to check the raw rows now. any chance the GA4 UTM job failed? I'm seeing fewer session events for the webinar landing page.
Samir (ops): Deploy job for utm-normalize failed yesterday at 02:17 with timeout. I restarted it but didn't reprocess backlog.
Maya (growth): ah ok. That would explain it. Dashboard uses last_touch by default — if sessions disappeared, last_touch MQLs would drop.
Terry (content): for context: we changed the webinar landing CTA copy last night. signups up ~8% but MQLs down. Could be form change affecting hidden fields.
Olivia (analytics): reprocessing backlog should restore sessions -> last_touch mapping. I'll re-run the attribution job with the safe window (7d lookback) and post results.
KPIsBot: [automated] Weekly KPI snapshot uploaded: https://dash.redwood.ai/leadflow/weekly/3219 — includes webinar cohort and channel splits :bar_chart:
Maya (growth): thanks. Olivia, can you confirm if any form field names changed? Terry, ping the design/dev who shipped the copy.
Terry (content): copied @dev-forms. They shipped a small rename: "utm_source" -> "utm_src" in the form payload by mistake. fixing now.
Samir (ops): I'll queue a re-ingest for the 24h window and then run the normalize + attribution pipeline. ETA 45m.
Olivia (analytics): re-run complete. After reprocessing, webinar->MQL conversion back to expected range. The drop was indeed from the utm rename causing the normalize job to drop values.
Maya (growth): great catch. Action items:
- Terry: add a preflight checklist for form field names (owners + test case)
- Samir: add alert on utm-normalize failures (pager if backlog > 1k)
- Olivia: add multi-touch view to weekly dashboard (so we don't rely solely on last_touch)
Samir (ops): noted. I'll add the alert and include runbook steps.
Terry (content): will add checklist to the launch doc and retro notes.
Maya (growth): Can we surface a one-line note in Monday's KPI email: "webinar MQL dip resolved — caused by form payload mismatch; reprocessing restored counts" — Olivia, Samir, thumbs?
Olivia (analytics): :thumbsup:
Samir (ops): :thumbsup:
KPIsBot: [automated] Added note to weekly_kpis channel.
Maya (growth): closing this thread — thanks team. Will discuss multi-touch adoption in Friday's KPI review.
